version.promotionalText: Private cadet rosters, secure server photo search, hidden previews, saved finds, family notes, and a plain-English academy terms guide.
version.description:
CadetCatch helps Coast Guard Academy families keep up with cadet photos without digging through every gallery by hand.

Create a private roster on your iPhone, add a clear cadet face photo, check the CadetCatch server photo index for possible matches, review match details, view selected results, save likely finds, and keep simple notes for family follow-up.

Photo indexing and source ingestion are handled by the CadetCatch backend. Private albums stay private unless you choose to use an accessible image source through the CadetCatch service.

Privacy Policy: https://eb28.co/cc/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
version.whatsNew: CadetCatch build 88 moves photo matching to the CadetCatch server search API, uploads the selected cadet photo for matching, displays returned full-photo results, adds clearer no-face/multiple-face/no-match/server-error states, and keeps match scores and debug details hidden from normal users.

notes: Add a cadet profile from Roster using a clear face photo selected from Photos.
Open Sources to confirm that matching uses the CadetCatch Search API. Source discovery, face embeddings, indexing, and photo hosting are backend/admin work, not phone work.

Open Home and run Check Photos. The app uploads the selected cadet photo to the secure search endpoint, shows loading state, and then displays possible matches returned by the backend. Previews stay hidden until single-photo or monthly access is active.
Open Photos to review possible matches, view a photo, save it, and create a family note.

Open Photo Access from More or a locked photo. The monthly subscription screen shows Family Monthly, 1 month, the monthly price, auto-renewal text, Restore Purchases, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Use (EULA) before purchase.
If the backend detects no face, multiple faces, no matches, or a server error, the app shows a clear state instead of showing unrelated results.

testedFlows: add cadet with selected profile photo
photo check with hidden result previews and no-face/multiple-face/no-match/server-error handling
purchase sheet with visible Family Monthly title, 1 month duration, price per month, auto-renewal disclosure, Privacy Policy link, Terms of Use (EULA) link, and restore purchase controls
daily photo check toggle in More
photo review, view, in-app save, and Save to Photos flow
Save to Photos writes an unlocked live server image to the iOS simulator Photos library
knownRisks: Photo URLs may reflect the current backend hosting path until final R2 photo hosting is complete.
Source discovery, face embeddings, indexing, and photo hosting are handled by the CadetCatch backend/admin pipeline, not by the iPhone app.

Build 88 preserves the supplied low-resolution USCGC EAGLE photo from the owner as the native iOS launch/splash image and welcome image, with the screenshot UI badge removed and no replacement EAGLE artwork.
In-app purchase products must be active in App Store Connect before TestFlight purchase flows can return live products.
